messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Diet and nutrition, General health and well-being, Medication and treatment, and Specific diseases, disorders and medical conditions in German Democratic Republic (1949-1990) during the 1980s and 1990s, matching this research need: Survey data on health education, self-reported health, dental hygiene and examinations, nutrition, information-seeking about illness and prevention, substance risks, sexual health, family health responsibility, school performance, and parental involvement.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: DDR Jugend Gesundheitserziehung Befragung Zahnpflege Ernährung Eltern Schulleistung 1988 Datensatz
GESIS DDR Jugend Gesundheit Ernährung Sexualität Eltern Fragebogen 1990 dataset
DDR 1980 1990 health survey dental hygiene nutrition school parental involvement data archive

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Schülerintervallstudie Gesundheitserziehung und Gesunderhaltung 1987 bis 1991 (Welle 1 bis 3)","url_or_doi":"https://access.gesis.org/dbk/13493","justification":"Excellent match and the most directly relevant dataset identified. This longitudinal survey of schoolchildren in the German Democratic Republic, conducted between 1987 and 1991, examines health education, self-reported health, dental hygiene, dental examinations, nutrition, dietary preferences, and preventive health behaviors. The questionnaires include questions about seeking information on illness, injuries, first aid, alcohol and nicotine risks, sexually transmitted diseases, skin conditions, toothaches, and diabetes. They also investigate parental responsibility for healthy eating, smoking, and dental care, as well as health education provided by parents, teachers, doctors, dentists, and nurses. The study is particularly valuable for investigating health knowledge, family influences, school-related experiences, and changes in health behavior during the transition from the GDR to reunified Germany."},{"title":"Gesundheit 1990 (Health 1990)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.6379","justification":"Highly relevant survey dataset collected in the former German Democratic Republic beginning in June 1990 by the Department of Medical Sociology at the Institute for Social Hygiene and Health Care Organization in Berlin. The survey covers individuals aged 14 and older and provides evidence for examining population health and health-related attitudes during the transition from the GDR to reunification. It is particularly relevant to research on general health and well-being, health-related behavior, and the social context of health care. Its detailed questionnaire should be consulted to determine which measures of medical treatment, prevention, and specific health conditions are available."},{"title":"Leben in der DDR 1990 (Life in the GDR 1990)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.6873","justification":"Relevant survey conducted in January 1990 in the GDR districts of Potsdam, Leipzig, and Schwerin. It examines social conditions and attitudes during the political and economic transformation of East Germany. The questionnaire includes the importance of health as a domain of life, knowledge about healthy lifestyles, social security, education, family relationships, and general life satisfaction. It is useful for examining health-related knowledge, perceived well-being, and the social and family contexts influencing health behavior. Although less focused on clinical conditions or dental hygiene, it provides valuable contextual measures for research on health education and well-being in the final year of the GDR."},{"title":"Alltagsprobleme Jugendlicher in der DDR 1988 (Everyday Problems of Young People in the GDR 1988)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.6086","justification":"Relevant historical youth survey conducted in the German Democratic Republic in 1988 by the Central Institute for Youth Research in Leipzig. It provides contemporary evidence on the everyday experiences and concerns of young people in the late GDR period. It is a potentially useful complementary dataset for investigating adolescent well-being, family relationships, educational experiences, and the social circumstances surrounding health behavior. Its relevance to specific questions about nutrition, dental care, substance use, and illness prevention requires verification against the questionnaire and variable documentation."},{"title":"Jugendstudie mit Gesundheitszusatzfragebogen (Youth Study with Supplementary Health Questionnaire)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.6096","justification":"Relevant GDR youth research dataset that includes a supplementary health questionnaire. The study examines young people's orientations and activities, including physical culture, sports participation, and health-related topics. It is useful for studying adolescent health behavior, physical activity, health awareness, and associations between lifestyle and educational or social characteristics during the 1980s. The supplementary health questionnaire makes it a promising source for additional measures of health and well-being, although the availability of specific nutrition, dental hygiene, and medical-treatment variables should be checked."},{"title":"Lebensbedingungen und Lebensweise von Schülern – Elternbefragung (Living Conditions and Lifestyles of Schoolchildren – Parent Survey)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.6471","justification":"Relevant survey of parents conducted between September 1989 and April 1990 as part of the broader GDR research project on the living conditions and lifestyles of schoolchildren. It provides a complementary parental perspective for studying family environments, educational experiences, parental involvement, and children's everyday lives during the final months of the GDR. It is especially useful for research on family responsibility and the relationship between parental attitudes and children's development. Its coverage of specific health education, nutrition, dental care, or preventive health practices needs to be established from the questionnaire."},{"title":"Schülerintervallstudie Fähigkeiten – Längsschnittuntersuchung (Longitudinal Study of Schoolchildren's Abilities)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.6121","justification":"Relevant longitudinal schoolchildren's survey associated with research on adolescent development, abilities, and risk situations in the GDR. The study belongs to a series of surveys that continued after reunification in eastern Germany through the project on adolescent risk situations and risk behavior. It is particularly useful for examining school performance, developmental outcomes, and educational factors that may be associated with health behavior and family influences. It offers a complementary perspective to the health education survey, although detailed coverage of nutrition, dental hygiene, and specific diseases is not established."}]}
